title: Node type stripping needs explicit .ts extensions in imports

problem.symptom: Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module './util' imported from main.ts
problem.description: When Node runs TypeScript directly, ESM resolution does not guess extensions. Import './util.ts' (and enable allowImportingTsExtensions in tsconfig for type checking).

limitations.proves: main.ts imports util.ts and runs with this runtime.
limitations.does_not_prove: That tsc accepts the import without allowImportingTsExtensions.
